schemas.$comment: The catalogue's show_component action: shows one component's page of the catalogue. Sent as the next step after the screen domain's mount_ext; the catalogue's handler replaces its own entry through its app's navigation facade. Self-contained and closed, as template-mfe's action schemas are.

target.$comment: The screen that shows the page: the only target of this action

component.$comment: The component to show, by its slug: one of the catalogue's components

seo.title: UI Kit
seo.description: Catalogue of @gears-frontx/ui-kit: live examples of all 64 components and the design token foundations, grouped and searchable.

/components/accordion.title: Accordion
/components/accordion.description: Accordion examples: stacked section headers that expand to show their content, one section at a time by default or several with multiple.

/components/alert.title: Alert
/components/alert.description: Alert examples: a page-level status message that sits in the flow of the page, with a title, a description, an optional icon and an action.

/components/alert-dialog.title: Alert Dialog
/components/alert-dialog.description: Alert Dialog examples: a modal confirmation that blocks the page until the user explicitly confirms or cancels, never closing on outside press.

/components/aspect-ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
/components/aspect-ratio.description: Aspect Ratio examples: a box held at a fixed width-to-height ratio so the layout around it does not shift while its content loads.

/components/attachment.title: Attachment
/components/attachment.description: Attachment examples: one file or image shown as a compact card with a preview, its name and details, its upload state and its actions.

/components/avatar.title: Avatar
/components/avatar.description: Avatar examples: a person's or account's picture in a fixed-size circle with a fallback, a status badge, sizes, tones and stacked groups.

/components/badge.title: Badge
/components/badge.description: Badge examples: a short static inline label in a compact pill, such as a count, a category tag or a status word, in paint and tone variants.

/components/breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
/components/breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb examples: a trail of ancestor links that shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy, ending in the current page.

/components/bubble.title: Bubble
/components/bubble.description: Bubble examples: one conversational turn framed as a speech bubble, with variants and alignment that mark which side of the chat it came from.

/components/button.title: Button
/components/button.description: Button examples: an action button in its variants and sizes, with icon-only, loading and disabled states.

/components/button-group.title: Button Group
/components/button-group.description: Button Group examples: adjacent buttons and controls joined into one strip with shared outer corners and collapsed inner borders.

/components/calendar.title: Calendar
/components/calendar.description: Calendar examples: inline month grids for picking one day, several days or a date range.

/components/card.title: Card
/components/card.description: Card examples: one self-contained unit of related content and its actions on a flat bordered surface, with header, content and footer.

/components/carousel.title: Carousel
/components/carousel.description: Carousel examples: a set of slides shown one viewport at a time, with previous and next controls to step through them.

/components/chart.title: Chart
/components/chart.description: Chart examples: themeable Recharts charts with a shared container, tooltip and legend, colored from a per-chart configuration.

/components/checkbox.title: Checkbox
/components/checkbox.description: Checkbox examples: a tick box that opts in or out of one independent option, with labels, descriptions and disabled states.

/components/collapsible.title: Collapsible
/components/collapsible.description: Collapsible examples: one section of content the user shows or hides in place from a trigger.

/components/combobox.title: Combobox
/components/combobox.description: Combobox examples: a text field with a filterable list of items that narrows as the user types, for picking one value or several.

/components/command.title: Command
/components/command.description: Command examples: a searchable, keyboard-navigable list of commands that filters and ranks its items by what the user types.

/components/context-menu.title: Context Menu
/components/context-menu.description: Context Menu examples: a menu of actions that an area of the page opens on right click or long press.

/components/data-table.title: Data Table
/components/data-table.description: Data Table examples: tabular data with sorting, optional row selection and pagination, built from one columns and data pair.

/components/date-picker.title: Date Picker
/components/date-picker.description: Date Picker examples: picking one day or a date range from a calendar that opens in a popover from a button or a typed field.

/components/dialog.title: Dialog
/components/dialog.description: Dialog examples: a centered modal popup opened from a trigger that blocks the rest of the page while it is open.

/components/direction.title: Direction
/components/direction.description: Direction examples: a provider that shares a left-to-right or right-to-left reading direction with the components below it.

/components/drawer.title: Drawer
/components/drawer.description: Drawer examples: an edge-anchored panel opened from a trigger that the user can dismiss with a swipe gesture.

/components/dropdown-menu.title: Dropdown Menu
/components/dropdown-menu.description: Dropdown Menu examples: a menu of actions opened from a trigger, with groups, separators, checkbox and radio items, and submenus.

/components/empty.title: Empty
/components/empty.description: Empty examples: a placeholder for a list, table or panel with nothing to show, explaining why and offering a way forward.

/components/field.title: Field
/components/field.description: Field examples: one form control laid out with its label, its description and its validation message.

/components/hover-card.title: Hover Card
/components/hover-card.description: Hover Card examples: a preview card that a link shows on hover or keyboard focus.

/components/input.title: Input
/components/input.description: Input examples: basic, in a field, disabled, invalid, file, inline and grid layouts, required, with a badge, in an input or button group, and in a form.

/components/input-group.title: Input Group
/components/input-group.description: Input Group examples: one text field and its addons, such as icons, text and compact actions, framed as a single field.

/components/input-otp.title: Input OTP
/components/input-otp.description: Input OTP examples: a fixed-length one-time code entered one character per slot and collected as one string value.

/components/item.title: Item
/components/item.description: Item examples: list rows that share one shape, with media, a title, a description and trailing actions, in outline and muted variants.

/components/kbd.title: Kbd
/components/kbd.description: Kbd examples: key caps and keyboard shortcuts marked up so they read as keys on screen, alone or grouped.

/components/label.title: Label
/components/label.description: Label examples: a caption that names a form control for assistive technology and drives the control when clicked.

/components/marker.title: Marker
/components/marker.description: Marker examples: status updates, system notes and labelled breaks inside a conversation thread, each as one muted full-width row.

/components/menubar.title: Menubar
/components/menubar.description: Menubar examples: a persistent row of application menus such as File, Edit and View, navigated with the arrow keys.

/components/message.title: Message
/components/message.description: Message examples: one conversation message laid out as a row, with an avatar beside its header, content surface and footer.

/components/message-scroller.title: Message Scroller
/components/message-scroller.description: Message Scroller examples: a scrolling message transcript that follows new content and floats a jump-to-latest button over its edge.

/components/native-select.title: Native Select
/components/native-select.description: Native Select examples: the browser's own select control in the kit's field styling, with the platform handling the popup.

/components/navigation-menu.title: Navigation Menu
/components/navigation-menu.description: Navigation Menu examples: a site navigation bar whose entries are plain links or triggers that expand into a shared panel of links.

/components/pagination.title: Pagination
/components/pagination.description: Pagination examples: links to each page of one paged result set, with previous and next controls and an ellipsis for skipped pages.

/components/popover.title: Popover
/components/popover.description: Popover examples: a floating panel that a trigger opens beside itself, for content and controls that do not need a modal.

/components/progress.title: Progress
/components/progress.description: Progress examples: a bar that shows how far a task has progressed, or that work is still running when progress cannot be measured.

/components/questionnaire.title: Questionnaire
/components/questionnaire.description: Questionnaire examples: a form that asks one question at a time, tracks answered and skipped items and validates each before moving on.

/components/radio-group.title: Radio Group
/components/radio-group.description: Radio Group examples: picking exactly one option from a small visible set, tracked as one shared value.

/components/resizable.title: Resizable
/components/resizable.description: Resizable examples: split panes the user resizes by dragging a handle, nested for multi-pane layouts.

/components/scroll-area.title: Scroll Area
/components/scroll-area.description: Scroll Area examples: a bounded region that scrolls with the kit's own scrollbar in place of the platform's native one.

/components/select.title: Select
/components/select.description: Select examples: a pick-one field whose trigger opens a popup list of options, with groups, labels and disabled items.

/components/separator.title: Separator
/components/separator.description: Separator examples: a thin horizontal or vertical line between two sections or items of content.

/components/sheet.title: Sheet
/components/sheet.description: Sheet examples: a panel anchored to one edge of the screen and opened from a trigger, on any of the four sides.

/components/sidebar.title: Sidebar
/components/sidebar.description: Sidebar examples: an application side panel that collapses off-canvas or to an icon rail and becomes a slide-in sheet on narrow screens.

/components/skeleton.title: Skeleton
/components/skeleton.description: Skeleton examples: pulsing placeholder shapes that stand in for content while it is still loading.

/components/slider.title: Slider
/components/slider.description: Slider examples: picking a number or a range of two numbers from a bounded scale by dragging, clicking the track or pressing arrow keys.

/components/spinner.title: Spinner
/components/spinner.description: Spinner examples: a small spinning glyph that shows something is loading, or a loading block with a label and a description.

/components/status-dot.title: Status Dot
/components/status-dot.description: Status Dot examples: a small round dot with an optional label in the same tone that reports the state of something.

/components/switch.title: Switch
/components/switch.description: Switch examples: a control that turns one independent setting on or off, with the change taking effect immediately.

/components/table.title: Table
/components/table.description: Table examples: tabular data as a styled native HTML table with a header, body, footer and caption, in density variants.

/components/tabs.title: Tabs
/components/tabs.description: Tabs examples: panels that share the same screen space, switched from a list of tabs with exactly one panel shown at a time.

/components/textarea.title: Textarea
/components/textarea.description: Textarea examples: a styled native multi-line text field that grows with its content.

/components/toast.title: Toast
/components/toast.description: Toast examples: brief transient notifications fired from code and stacked in a corner, with type icons and an optional action button.

/components/toggle.title: Toggle
/components/toggle.description: Toggle examples: a button that flips one independent on or off state, in default and outline variants and several sizes.

/components/toggle-group.title: Toggle Group
/components/toggle-group.description: Toggle Group examples: a small set of related toggle buttons where the user presses one option or several.

/components/tooltip.title: Tooltip
/components/tooltip.description: Tooltip examples: a short visual hint that a trigger shows on hover or keyboard focus.

/foundations/semantic-colors.title: Semantic Colors
/foundations/semantic-colors.description: Semantic color tokens of @gears-frontx/ui-kit: every color role the theme defines, shown as swatches in the current light or dark theme.

/foundations/typography.title: Typography
/foundations/typography.description: Type ramp tokens of @gears-frontx/ui-kit: each text role with its size, line height, weight and tracking, rendered as a specimen.

/foundations/layout-elevation.title: Layout & Elevation
/foundations/layout-elevation.description: Layout and elevation tokens of @gears-frontx/ui-kit: the radius scale, the spacing steps and the shadow and scrim tokens.
